playbookOutputs: Registered representative (public officer) recorded as active on the company's SARS profile
SARS confirmation letter / case outcome of the registered representative request
Signed power of attorney and cover letter on file
playbookCommonFailures: Certified ID of the public officer older than 3 months, or the certification stamp is illegible
Selfie/photo of the representative holding their ID not supplied or does not match the certified ID (SARS requests this in many cases)
Person nominated is not a director on the CoR14.3 and no director resolution/POA authorises them
Nominated person's own personal income tax affairs are not registered or not compliant
SARS case rejected because the CoR14.3 uploaded is an old version that does not show current directors

informationToProvide.label: COR14.3 (Company registration document) (e.g., CIPC COR14.3
informationToProvide.aiHint: Latest CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and CURRENT directors. If the nominated public officer is not listed as a director, a director resolution and POA are needed.

informationToProvide.label: ID copy of the person to be appointed as the Public Officer
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC/SARS KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS. Foreign nationals may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.
alternatives: Certified passport plus proof of SA residence

informationToProvide.label: Contact number of the person to be appointed as the Public Officer
informationToProvide.aiHint: SA cell number the representative can answer — SARS sends the OTP and verification call here. Must be a number the person actually controls.

informationToProvide.label: Email address of the person to be appointed as the Public Officer
informationToProvide.aiHint: Personal email of the representative; SARS correspondence and OTPs go here.

informationToProvide.label: ID copies of all directors as per company registration certificate
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC/SARS KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS. Foreign nationals may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Personal Income Tax number for the person who will be appointed as the Tax Rep
informationToProvide.aiHint: The nominated representative's own SARS income tax reference (10 digits, usually starting 0/1/2/3). SARS links the representative by this number; if the person has never been registered, they must register for personal income tax first.

informationToProvide.label: Clear Photo (Selfie) of the Nominated Public Officer Holding Their Original ID & Handwritten Note Reading "For SARS Purpose" with Current Date
informationToProvide.aiHint: Clear photo of the nominated representative holding their ID next to their face, taken recently. SARS frequently requests this during the registered representative case — ⚠ verify whether SARS still asks for it; collect upfront to avoid a second round.
informationToProvide.helpText: Mandatory for SARS Registered Representative activation: upload a clear photo showing the Public Officer face holding their ID and a handwritten note reading "For SARS Purpose" with today date.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address (< 3 Months) of Public Officer & Company Bank Confirmation Letter (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of residential address (< 3 months) for the nominated Public Officer and the company bank confirmation letter (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address (< 90 days) of the nominated Public Officer and official company bank confirmation letter.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary eFiling username for your personal or company profile. Please ensure the username is active.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Please test your password on sarsefiling.co.za before submitting to avoid delays or account lockouts. (Stored encrypted at rest).

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify Yes or No (does your eFiling login trigger an SMS OTP or SARS Mobile App push notification?).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Confirmation of whether SARS eFiling login requires multi-factor authentication (OTP/App push).

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select preferred date, time slot, and direct phone number so our team can coordinate live OTP approval.
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: If OTP is required, when is the best time and number to contact you?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client preferred date, time window, and contact number for live OTP coordination.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect representative and company documents
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads received, representative's tax number, cell and email captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Name each document and why SARS needs it: certified ID (within 3 months), CoR14.3 showing current directors, IDs of all directors, representative's tax number, and — because SARS often asks — a selfie holding the ID. Confirm the person is a director or will be authorised by resolution. Do not promise faster than 3-5 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify identity documents and authority
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: IDs certified within 90 days, names match the CoR14.3, representative is a director or authorised, tax number format valid
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Entity is the company; the representative is an individual director/officer. Match every director on the CoR14.3 to a certified ID. If the nominee is not a director, add a director_resolution to the drafting step. Check the ID photo against the selfie if supplied.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft power of attorney, cover letter and (if needed) director resolution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Drafts generated from verified facts and posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: POA: company appoints the nominated public officer / My Accountant for SARS matters; use the SARS special power of attorney wording (⚠ verify the current SARS POA form — SPPOA/TPPOA — is used where SARS insists on its own form). Cover letter explains the appointment and lists attachments. Resolution only when the nominee is not a director. Never invent director names — pull from the CoR14.3.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send POA and resolution to client for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Plain instructions: sign where marked, date, return as PDF. Remind that the representative must keep their phone available for a SARS OTP/verification call.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit registered representative request on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Request submitted with all supporting documents and SARS case number recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Path: SARS Registered Details > Activate Registered Representative (or via SARS Online Query System 'Register a Representative' if eFiling access is blocked — ⚠ verify which route SARS currently accepts). Upload: certified ID of representative, IDs of directors, CoR14.3, signed POA, cover letter, selfie where requested, proof of the representative's tax number. Kevin submits because SARS may demand additional documents case by case.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for SARS verification and activation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Representative shows active on SARS Registered Details or SARS outcome letter received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the case status and SARS correspondence at each follow-up. If SARS asks for further documents (commonly the selfie or a newer certified ID) create a proposal for Kevin and a client message listing exactly what is needed. Log the case number on every contact.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver confirmation of appointment
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Confirmation letter / screenshot of active representative posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain what the representative can now do (activate tax types, request TCS, file returns) and that their contact details must be kept current with SARS. Offer the PAYE/VAT registration or annual compliance services that were blocked before.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
